headline: Launch it. Run your file. Get a checked result.
summary: Usable now on one local Windows PC. One command opens the local console. The two retained M2 capabilities convert a file to canonical JSON or merge a batch with whole-file quarantine, run in the pinned container, and are checked by an independent oracle before download. Restart, replay and revoke behave as recorded. Zero model calls.
limitations: Narrow id,group,bytes contract; trusted local scope with the SQ-1 store-writer limit unchanged; rollback can only reach the M2 baseline; usability evidence, not Level A, Level B or a new held-out study.
